CommunityApplications.Profile:
Self-hosted apps I build and run on Unraid.
**Available templates:**
- **Facet** — a self-hosted personal profile platform. Create multiple views of your professional profile for different audiences (recruiters, conferences, clients). You own your data and control what each audience sees. - **Translarr** — an AI subtitle translator for the arr stack. Plugs into Sonarr, Radarr, Emby, and Jellyfin. When a release lands with subtitles in the wrong language, Translarr extracts the track, translates it with an LLM, adapts timing for the target language's reading rate, and drops a clean `.srt` next to the video.
All templates are open source under MIT. Support and issues via the GitHub repo for each app.
